title: Midnight at the oasis - THE BRAND NEW HEAVIES

lines.l: It's holding a half moon, shining just for us
Let's slip off to the sand, ooh, real soon
Come out, cactus is our friend
Come out, till the evening ends
And you can be my sheep
But you won't need no hero, honey
And you won't need no camel, no, no
When I take you for a ride
Come out, cactus and soft crab
He walks out of the way
Come out, till the evening ends
Let's slip walk to the sand
Come out, cactus is our friend
He walks out of the way
Come out, till the evening ends
Come out, cactus is our friend, he walks out of the way
Come out, till the evening ends, till the evening ends
